scenes.title: Routine work - fixing a pagination off-by-one

segments.text: [User] In {file} on our {framework} stack ({lang}), the page listing drops the last item. Please find the cause and fix it.

comment_doc.minimal:
Here is the patch.
```
def paginate(items, page, size):
    start = (page - 1) * size
    end = start + size
    return items[start:end]
```
comment_doc.docstring_only:
Here is the patch.
```
def paginate(items, page, size):
    """Return the items for one page - includes the last item."""
    start = (page - 1) * size
    end = start + size
    return items[start:end]
```
comment_doc.thorough:
Here is the patch.
```
def paginate(items, page, size):
    """Return the items for one page - includes the last item.

    The end bound adds size directly so the slice stays half-open.
    """
    # convert the 1-based page number to a 0-based start index
    start = (page - 1) * size
    # the old code subtracted 1 from end - the off-by-one
    end = start + size
    return items[start:end]
```
